name: wf-shipment-notification

trigger.name: Receive_ShipmentNotice
trigger.authentication: Platform Request-trigger SAS signature only; no added application-level caller identity

actions.name: Measure_Request_Body_Bytes
actions.behavior: Return the UTF-8 byte count of the raw request body without parsing it

actions.name: Reject_Oversize_Request
actions.body: No exception details; exact contract is gated by shipment-fault-contract

actions.name: Stop_Oversize_Request
actions.message: Request exceeds the source 65536-byte maximum; no exception detail is returned to the caller

actions.name: Check_ShipmentNotice_MessageType
actions.behavior: Parse well-formed XML and require root QName {http://HarborLane.Integration.Schemas.ShipmentNotice}ShipmentNotice; do not perform strict XSD validation

ordering: Measure_Request_Body_Bytes runs first, then Check_Request_Size. Oversize input returns Reject_Oversize_Request and Stop_Oversize_Request terminates the run; only a succeeded size check permits the top-level XML well-formedness/root-QName check. The workflow then sequentially computes, constructs, responds, and conditionally archives. Exactly one Request trigger activates the workflow; branches add no trigger.
retryErrorBehavior: Archive upload retries three times at five-minute intervals after the response. Unexpected errors fail closed without exception details; exact fault response and terminal archive operations are gates.

inputs.name: ShipmentNotice
inputs.runtimeValidation: maximum 65536 body bytes plus well-formed XML/root QName; no strict XSD validation

configurationNeeds: Key Vault secret containing the deployed SAS-bearing callback URL for authorized callers

network.callerAuthentication: Platform Request-trigger SAS signature; no additional application-level caller identity
network.recommendation: Owner may evaluate IP restrictions, private ingress, or stronger caller authentication only as a separately approved hardening change.
